reason: The cited evidence confirms the BCC HEA is a dirty-limit s-wave BCS superconductor (E2, E4) and that Tc variations are not disorder-driven (E2, E4), but no evidence supports the central premise that configurational entropy enhances electron-phonon coupling or that reducing it lowers Tc; E1 only reports robust superconductivity under pressure.
premises: High configurational entropy enhances electron-phonon coupling in BCC HEAs
Reducing configurational entropy (at constant e/a, lattice, phase) lowers Tc
The HEA (TaNbHfZrTi) is a dirty-limit BCS s-wave superconductor
Tc variations in (TaNb)1-x(ZrHfTi)x are not driven by disorder
